cohort: This study analyzed data from 12,218 emergency cesarean deliveries performed over a three-year period at a tertiary care center.
finding: Among emergency cesarean cases, bladder injury occurred in 0.18% of cases, with significant risk factors including a history of previous cesarean sections, adherent placenta, and intraoperative adhesions.
mod_finding: A history of previous cesarean sections was identified as a significant risk factor for bladder injury during emergency cesarean deliveries.
